title: spec: the describe() of relatedList 'primary' and of enable.trackHistory still narrate the v2 record page (own tab, History tab) after the v3 layout
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

## Observed (PR #27310, the record page v3 layout, branch head `aef002ff60`)

Two published contract texts in `packages/spec` describe the v2 synthesized record page, which the v3 layout retires:

1. `relatedList: 'primary'` (`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`) — the `.describe()` says the list is promoted to its own tab. On the v3 synthesized page a primary list is a full-width body table after the first field group (`bodyTablePlacement` in `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`); the #27069 wording on `ObjectSchema.relatedLists` already says "places" a list.
2. `enable.trackHistory` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) — the `.describe()` says "Show the record History tab", and the generated `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` repeats it. On the v3 page field changes join the one timeline stream (the 「变更」 chip); there is no History tab on the synthesized page.

Both are docblock / describe prose, no schema shape change; the generated reference pages and the `authorable-surface` baseline follow whatever the describe says.

## Reach

Named producer: `packages/spec` describe text, read by the Studio inspector help, the generated references and the skills. Not a runtime behaviour.

## Target

Reword both describes to the v3 page (a primary list is a body table in the details column; `trackHistory` feeds field changes into the record's timeline stream and, on an authored page, the History block), regenerate the references and the baseline, no key change. Lands after PR #27310 (the behaviour it describes).

Governing text: the two `.describe()` strings; AGENTS.md on docblocks describing what the runtime does; ADR-0087 (describe-only changes need no conversion).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` on 2026-10-28 from PR #27310's out-of-scope findings (class b, named producer), under epic #26676.</sub>
